Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "Bond of Master and Disciple" Category allies' ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Randomly changes Ki Spheres of a certain Type (AGL & INT
excluded) to Rainbow Ki Spheres
*Per "Bond of Master and Disciple" Category ally on the team*
- Ki +3 (up to +9)
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 150%)
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
(up to 60%)
*When attacking with 18 or more Ki*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For 1 turn from the character's entry turn*
- Guards all attacks
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g},
plus an additional chance of performing a critical hit & damage
reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g} and all allies' ATK 30%{passiveImg:up_g} as the 1st attacker
in a turn
*For 3 turns from the character's entry turn*
- Launches an additional attack that has a great chance of becoming
a Super Attack
*After an ally's Revival Skill is activated*
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}Guards all attacks
